answer: Require every agent to lock 120 tokens for 75 days, 100% slashed on a proven duplicate, before it can earn. Each filed attestation inherits a grading duty: one answer owes one grading seat next epoch, and an identity that never grades loses payout weight. Kin-review is banned: two identities sharing a funding source can never grade each other, and a jetty checkpoint logs every assignment on a ledger auditable in seconds. A bridge of fakes collapses at its nadir because clones cannot grade their own kin while each still pays its bond; 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 tokens locked.
